name: PlaceIQ
tagline: Placement analytics that tells every student what to fix next
problem: Placement cells track hundreds of students in spreadsheets
They learn who got placed only after the drive is over
Students don't know which skill gap matters most
Departments can't see weak trends early enough to act

stats.label: engineering seats a year in India (AICTE intake, approx.)
graduate employability in industry surveys (approx., varies)

solution: Upload the placement sheet (or load demo) and get instant auto-EDA
Explainable model predicts each student's placement chance
Optimiser finds the least-effort plan that lifts them above 70%
At-risk call list, personas and a fairness audit for the cell

features.title: What to fix next
features.desc: Exact minimum-effort counterfactual plan per student, ranked by effort

features.title: Why this prediction
features.desc: Coefficient x standardised value bars that add up to the score

features.title: What-if simulator
features.desc: 12 sliders with a live probability gauge and re-planning

features.title: At-risk list
features.desc: Threshold slider, top gap per student, one-click CSV export

features.title: Student personas
features.desc: k-means++ clusters such as Coding stars and Toppers lacking projects

features.title: Fairness check
features.desc: Per-department FPR, FNR and calibration gap on out-of-fold predictions

architecture: Browser UI -> vanilla JS, hand-drawn SVG charts, live simulator
app.py -> stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer, JSON API, input validation
data.py -> latent-model cohort generator + CSV row validation
models.py / metrics.py -> LogReg GD+L2, ridge, AUC, ROC, F1, R2
cluster.py / engine.py -> k-means++ personas, fairness, dashboards
algorithms: Logistic regression (gradient descent, L2) - placement probability
Ridge linear regression (normal equations) - expected package
Bounded knapsack DP - minimum-effort counterfactual plan
Rank-based ROC-AUC, Pearson correlation - evaluation and EDA
innovation: Prescribes the cheapest realistic fix, not just a probability
Glass-box: chart, simulator and plan use one exact model
Effort costs and caps are editable named assumptions
Department excluded from the model, then audited for fairness

results.label: cold start: data + 9 models, pure Python

demo_flow: Overview: KPIs, MECH lagging, who to call first
Student coach: Tarun M at 40% and why
What to fix next: +10 aptitude, +3 hackathons -> 71%
Simulator: drag backlogs, watch the gauge move

impact: Students get a ranked to-do list, not 'improve your profile'
~200 at-risk students found before drives, not after
Personas turn into targeted workshops per batch
Runs on any lab PC, so small colleges benefit too
business: Free open-source edition for single colleges
Paid multi-campus edition with history and role logins
Opt-in readiness-verified talent pipeline for hiring firms
future: Effort costs learned from students who improved
